hotspots.title: House GOP Impeachment Push Against Pete Hegseth
hotspots.blurb: House Republicans narrowly voted 211-204 to derail a direct impeachment vote against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, referring the resolution to the Judiciary Committee instead. Despite surviving the immediate floor vote, Hegseth remains under intense political pressure from Democrats and military critics over defense policies, Iran, and leadership controversies.
hotspots.affect: The high-stakes party-line maneuver to shield Hegseth from formal removal has triggered explosive partisan warfare and accusations of spinelessness in Washington.

hotspots.title: Pope Leo XIV & Javier Milei Dueling Visions Clash
hotspots.blurb: Pope Leo XIV's visit to Argentina concluded amid deepening political controversy and ideological friction with President Javier Milei. Public backlash erupted over a 'VIP tent' commercialization scheme allegedly tied to Karina Milei, while the president conspicuously avoided attending key papal masses in Luján and Córdoba.
hotspots.affect: The stark contrast between Papal social advocacy and Milei's radical libertarian austerity sparked widespread public outrage, corruption accusations, and intense social media hostility.

hotspots.title: Santiago Abascal & David Broncano TV Clash
hotspots.blurb: Vox leader Santiago Abascal's appearance on David Broncano's popular talk show 'La Revuelta' threw public broadcaster RTVE into crisis. Host Broncano publicly apologized and expressed disappointment with his own interview performance, while conservative outlets accused public television executives of panicking and attempting to censor Vox.
hotspots.affect: The fallout from the television encounter ignited a fierce national controversy over media bias, censorship, and the political framing of far-right leaders.

hotspots.title: Krakow Mass Shooting & Far-Right Suspect
hotspots.blurb: Polish law enforcement continues to investigate potential far-right extremist ties to a mass shooting in Krakow, revealing the gunman was obsessed with extremist websites and terror figures. The investigation has sparked bitter domestic political combat, with the Tusk administration and opposition PiS trading accusations over security failures and ideological spin.
hotspots.affect: The rare mass violence paired with ideological radicalization has generated profound national grief, security alarm, and partisan blame-shifting.

hotspots.title: Viktor Orbán's Brother Arrested in Human Smuggling Probe
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian authorities detained Áron Orbán, the younger brother of Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, in connection with an international human trafficking probe. Opposition leader Péter Magyar and Tisza party figures immediately seized on the arrest to attack Fidesz's anti-immigration narrative.
hotspots.affect: The criminal detention of the Prime Minister's brother directly undermines Fidesz's core political identity, driving high-stakes scandal coverage and hypocrisy claims.
